config.reference_basis: 沿用原作者RT-qPCR方法的UBC；本轮不独立证明内参稳定性。
config.independence_basis: 作者标记N1至N4代表4次induction；探索性以induction为配对单位，同源细胞系统而非4名供体。
config.paired_plate_basis: 主文Methods及Figure2A：4次独立induction，同一批两培养条件同步分化及检测；每对在同一RDML板。仅合并板内ΔCq差，不合并跨板原Cq或宣称通用跨板校准。
config.equal_efficiency_basis: 沿用作者2^(-ΔΔCt)方法的等效率假设；原RDML无测定效率，属于明确假设下的探索性计算。

parameters.figures: Individual biological sample points and complete-pair lines, no symmetric fold error bars.
parameters.missing: Undetected/missing/excluded wells retained with reason, no zero/max-cycle imputation; feature complete cases or complete pairs.
parameters.interval: Mean tests: 95% pointwise log-scale CI, exponentiated ordered endpoints; rank methods have no fold CI.
warnings: 逐板相对定量；仅显式确认的同板配对差可合并检验，不合并 Cq 或宣称跨板校准。
parameters.direction: positive delta Cq numerator-minus-denominator means lower expression; effect_value is log2 expression numerator-minus-denominator
parameters.correction: BH over all frozen target x contrast x plate-stratum tests; NA internally 1 and restored NA.
parameters.limitations: Software checks are not experimental quality certification or biological validation.
